Oneliner

Educational mission with digipeater and testing gamma-ray burst sensor.
Description

Packet radio services in the VHF and UHF amateur bands as well as an experimental Sband downlink module. In addition, GRBBeta contains experimental payloads, including an upgraded version of the gamma-ray detector subsystem and attitude determination and control systems along with technologies allowing onboard firmware upgrade (that also have flight heritage on GRBAlpha). This latter feature also allows both the fine-tuning and the complete upgrade of the radio FEC parameters on the fly.
Results

Initial rotation rates were over 18 degrees per second, but slowing down with only passive attitude control.
First gamma-ray burst detected.
